DVDs can now be renewed twice. In `lib/config/defaults.js`, the `dvd` entry in `LOAN_RULES` now has `maxRenewals: 2`, up from 1. Books stay at 2, and magazines and laptops stay at 0.

`renewLoan` reads its limit from `LOAN_RULES`, so no other code needed changing. In `test/renewals.test.js` I renamed the DVD test to "renews a DVD at most twice". It now checks that two renewals succeed and a third returns `renewal-limit`. All 59 tests pass.
